Global Tensions Drive Oil Prices Up, Affecting Markets

Rising crude oil prices, influenced by escalating tensions between the US and Iran, are impacting global markets. This surge is leading to concerns about potential increases in petrol and diesel prices in India. The situation is also affecting stock markets and currency values, with the US dollar strengthening against other major currencies.
